contexts.text: The planets cannot be empty masses. Explained.
That the planets are Earths. Explained.
How a planet appears to Spirits.
The spiritual position of the planets. Described.
Spirits appear near their own planet; but outside it.
No planet is seen by Spirits. AC 7800, Explained.
The planets do not appear to wander as in the world; but appear constantly in their own places. AC 7358.
The Spirits of the several planets are separated from each other; and are near their own orbs. Explained.
The fixed stars have planets round them, which are Earths.
All the planets... are Earths; and there are innumerable ones in the universe, all full of inhabitants.
The Earths which are called planets...

When I represented Earths to them... They said that they know there are many Earths... And when I represented in a spiritual manner the planets called Mercury and Venus, they directed my sight to the planet Venus, (by which) I perceived that they were from the planet nearest the sun.
They were relegated towards their own planet.
The inhabitants of the planets have been present with me.
Makes a vortex around the planets.
